# model.createMix

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Create a mix.

```lua
model.createMix()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
model.createMix("free", {actions={{action="offset", condition=armSwitch, active=100, inactive=0}}})
```
